name: claudesec
description: Zero-config, fully-local security observatory for your AI coding agents. Tails Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Codex session transcripts in real time — no env vars, no agent restart — and scores every tool call, command, and file access against a built-in threat-detection engine. Nothing leaves your machine.
author: The ClaudeSec Authors
